text: Implemented the design-only LSS TrialReadout in shared fit: validated TrialCoefficientAxis/estimability metadata, cached Gale operator with true adjoint and fixed-nuisance projection folded in, and routed LeastSquaresSeparate.fit through the same forward map. Added fMRILSS/oracle parity, nuisance-invariance, adjoint, A(YW)=(AY)W, batch reuse, zero-regressor, and typed-failure tests plus README/plan status. Exact current tree passes fitJVM/test (144) and fitJS/test (136); git diff --check is clean.
